snippet.title: Claw and Conjure - Official Trailer (Indie Auto-Battler)
snippet.description:
Would you play this game?
⭐ Wishlist Claw and Conjure here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4290080/Claw_and_Conjure?utm_source=trailer_a

Claw and Conjure is a fantasy RPG auto-battler where you build up a town to attract the units you need for a fun and synergistic build. Clash with real players in async PvP, discover powerful synergies, and outmaneuver your opponents to rule the empire.

If you enjoy games like Backpack Battles, the Bazaar, TFT, Hearthstone Battlegrounds, Oaken Tower, or Batomon Showdown, this game might be for you!
